page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.30xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 120 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 8490H processors operating at a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz. This instance is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 17.07 GB per core.

The ecs.re8.30xlarge does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring all storage operations to be conducted via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The absence of local storage represents a tradeoff, as disk I/O performance will depend entirely on the attached network storage volumes, though the massive 2048.0 GB RAM capacity allows for extensive in-memory caching and data processing to mitigate network storage latency.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density resource profile designed for enterprise workloads that require massive memory footprints. By consolidating large-scale databases or analytical workloads onto a single instance with 2048.0 GB of RAM, organizations can reduce the overhead associated with distributed cluster management. The hardware configuration is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, real-time data analytics, and memory-intensive scientific computing.
